---
name: Protocol proposal
description: Discuss a versioned protocol extension before implementing it
labels: [protocol, proposal]
---

## Interoperability gap
Provide an example involving two independently implemented systems.

## Normative semantics
Define inputs, outputs, state transitions, authorization, and edge cases.

## Example wire exchange
Use sanitized JSON. No credentials or sensitive operational data.

## Compatibility plan
What would older clients and observers do with this message?

## Negative cases
Duplicates, late evidence, clock changes, authentication and failures.

## Conformance tests
List independent implementation test vectors that prove the behavior.
